snippet.title: Contract Cooks | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A co-op cooking game where you take on contract jobs across a range of kitchens in the food industry. Play solo or with a friend, prepare dishes, complete shifts, and build up your experience to unlock more contracts.

Wishlist now on Steam 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4301410/Contract_Cooks/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=wishlist_push&utm_content=description_link

Developed by Potato Peoples (@Slapunas and @jakayaki)

"Bumbly March" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)
